subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: After the duplicate wake path is removed, should yielded cron parents use a permanent public and persisted `deferred` status across Gateway, CLI, hooks, plugin SDK, and UI?
rationale: Current main already owns the internal descendant-settlement wake mechanism; repository history cannot determine whether OpenClaw should additionally commit to this new compatibility-sensitive external status contract.

options.title: Adopt after consolidation
options.body: Keep `deferred` only after canonical lifecycle reuse, compatibility tests, upgrade proof, and exact-head Discord proof.

options.title: Keep waiting internal
options.body: Fix cron and Discord behavior without adding a new persisted or externally visible status.

options.title: Split for design review
options.body: Land narrow behavior fixes separately and review the public status contract as a dedicated proposal.

recommendation.title: Adopt after consolidation
recommendation.body: Keep `deferred` only after canonical lifecycle reuse, compatibility tests, upgrade proof, and exact-head Discord proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work spans the cron, Discord progress, and shared reply-runtime surfaces affected by this cross-product contract choice.
